msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia juguetes-duba-33.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a pink 1:8 nitro RC racing car on a race track, no logos, no stickers from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia juguetes-duba-39.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a green 1:10 RC rock crawler off-road truck, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EFECE6) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia juguetes-duba-33.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a pink 1:8 GT nitro RC car, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EFECE6) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia juguetes-duba-30.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of an unpainted white and blue RC car body shell from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EFECE6) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of an orange 1:10 electric RC buggy, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EFECE6) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
